title: Staff Call API Endpoints Integration
description: Complete RESTful API for staff call intelligence workflow. Handles recording uploads, status polling, AI result review, SSOT submission, and call rejection. Fully integrated with transcription and audio storage services.
features: POST /api/calls/upload - Upload recording with multipart form-data
GET /api/calls/:id - Poll call status and get AI extraction results
POST /api/calls/:id/submit - Submit reviewed call to CRM (SSOT integration)
POST /api/calls/:id/reject - Discard call and delete recording
GET /api/calls - Call history with pagination and filters
Agent JWT authentication on all endpoints
Ownership verification (agents can only access their own calls)
Signed URL generation for secure audio playback
Zod validation schemas for request data
Full SSOT integration: Contact, VoiceCall, Interaction, LeadScore
acceptance_criteria: Android app can upload recording successfully
Signed URLs work for audio playback
SSOT integration creates all required records
Lead score updated on call submission
result_summary: Complete API implementation with 6 endpoints covering full staff call workflow. Integrated with audio_storage.ts and transcription services. Full SSOT compliance with transactional updates. Production-ready with authentication, validation, and logging.
